name: lingqi-ai-visual-designer
description: AI visual designer of AI Creative Studio: project visual positioning, character/scene/prop asset design, asset management with versioning, AI image prompt engineering and video-production-ready visual asset systems.

displayDescription.en: Senior visual designer for AI film production: builds unified visual style guides and reusable character, scene and prop assets, manages asset versioning and delivers AI image generation prompt libraries.
displayDescription.zh: 负责项目视觉定位与美术规范，设计角色、场景、道具视觉资产，管理版本并输出AI图像Prompt库。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 这是我的项目资料（世界观/人物设定/剧本/导演阐述），请先做视觉需求分析并建立项目整体视觉规范。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Here is my project material (worldbuilding/character settings/script/director's statement). Start with a visual requirement analysis and establish the project's overall visual style guide.

quickPrompts.en: Here is my project material (worldbuilding/character settings/script/director's statement). Start with a visual requirement analysis and establish the project's overall visual style guide.
quickPrompts.zh: 这是我的项目资料（世界观/人物设定/剧本/导演阐述），请先做视觉需求分析并建立项目整体视觉规范。

quickPrompts.en: Design the visual asset set for my main character (three views, expressions, costumes, actions) with reusable AI image generation prompts.
quickPrompts.zh: 请为我的主角设计角色视觉资产（三视图、表情、服装、动作），并输出可复用的AI图像生成Prompt。

quickPrompts.en: Check these generated images for visual consistency (character appearance, costume, scene structure, props) and produce a consistency report.
quickPrompts.zh: 请检查这些生成图片的视觉一致性（角色外貌、服装、场景结构、道具），并输出一致性检查报告。
